hero.description: Race to collect items across five Store Boards, fulfill Jastip Orders, and pack your Suitcase and Carry-on luggage within space and weight limits before your return flight.

hybrid.title: Combining Tabletop Experience with iOS Technology
hybrid.description: Physical Store Boards, Item Cards, and player pawns work together with the JASTIP iOS companion app.
tabletopPoints: Move your pawn across the five Store Boards to visit different stores
Take available Item Cards from a store's Display Slots
iosPoints: Scan Item Card QR codes in the app to register each item
Pack items into your Suitcase and Carry-on luggage grids while managing weight limits
Track 3 Shared Jastip Orders and add Personal Jastip Orders for listed points

features.title: Packing Grid
features.description: Rotate and place scanned Item Cards into your Suitcase and Carry-on grids within weight limits for Perfect Fit and Perfect Weight bonuses.

features.title: Multiplayer
features.description: Compete with 2-5 players across rounds representing days before your return flight, with app-determined turn order and store restocks.

features.title: Jastip Orders
features.description: Complete 3 Shared Jastip Orders and pick Personal Jastip Orders in the app for listed points while adapting to Random Events.

howToPlay.title: Goal
howToPlay.description: Race against time across five Store Boards to fulfill Jastip Orders and pack your luggage before your flight home. Most money at the end wins.

howToPlay.title: Setup
howToPlay.description: Lay out all five Store Boards with 3 face-up Item Cards each, give every player a pawn, and start the match in the JASTIP iOS app.

howToPlay.title: Play!
howToPlay.description: Take up to 2 actions per turn—Move Pawn, Take Item (scan QR), or Add Personal Orders—then stores shift and restock before the next day.

howToPlay.title: Scoring
howToPlay.description: After the Last Day, score filled luggage grids (+$10), completed Jastip Orders, and Perfect Fit/Weight bonuses—minus incomplete orders and overweight penalties.

previews.title: Suitcase & Carry-on Packing
previews.subtitle: Scan items & manage weight limits
previews.caption: Track turn order and days remaining before boarding, scan Store Item Cards into your Staging Area, and rotate or drag items into your Suitcase and Carry-on within grid and weight limits.

previews.title: Scoring Details Receipt
previews.subtitle: Grids, bonuses, orders & penalties
previews.caption: Inspect an itemized end-of-game breakdown covering filled luggage grids, Perfect Fit and Perfect Weight bonuses, fulfilled or incomplete Jastip Orders, and any Staging Area or overweight penalties.

previews.title: Final Standings
previews.subtitle: 2-5 player match leaderboard
previews.caption: Compare total income, penalties, and final money across 2-5 players at the table to crown the winning Jastipper after the Last Day.

footer.description: A competitive hybrid tabletop and iOS board game for 2-5 players—collect Item Cards across five Store Boards, fulfill Jastip Orders, and pack your luggage before your return flight.
